reason: I already hand out free services to creators every week and have no idea if any of it brings people in, so a free trial that just counts it is worth a shot. ₹299 is nothing next to what I give away in freebies.
objection: It only works if the creator sends me the link, and the good creators won't bother with some beta tool; plus my staff are busy and will forget to type the PIN or note the code, so the count will look low and I won't trust it.
would_change_my_mind: If in the first couple of weeks the creators who DM me won't use the link or my staff can't keep up with the codes, I'd drop it.
